claims.text: DFT calculations can optimize phase stability in materials with variable composition and microstructure.
DFT calculations can refine the microstructure of materials with variable composition and microstructure.
DFT calculations can enhance material properties.
The proposed intervention is the application of DFT calculations using ab initio methods.
Electronic structure and atomic arrangement mediate the proposed effects of DFT-guided optimization.
Ab initio simulation of electronic and atomic interactions enables prediction of phase stability.
Ab initio simulation of electronic and atomic interactions enables microstructure refinement.
Ab initio simulation of electronic and atomic interactions enables property optimization.
DFT-guided development will improve phase stability by 20% relative to trial-and-error approaches.
DFT-guided development will improve microstructure refinement by 15% relative to trial-and-error approaches.
DFT-guided development will enhance material properties by 10% relative to trial-and-error approaches.
The accuracy of DFT calculations depends on the selected exchange-correlation functional.
Material-system complexity can affect the accuracy of DFT calculations and the predicted outcomes.
